content.text: Advanced architectural patterns and interview-ready system designs for building production-grade distributed applications.

items: Rate Limiting — Token bucket, leaky bucket, sliding window, and distributed rate limiting
API Design — REST principles, versioning, pagination, error handling, and GraphQL tradeoffs
Event-Driven Architecture — Event sourcing, CQRS, saga pattern, and exactly-once delivery
Microservices Patterns — Service mesh, circuit breakers, saga orchestration, and decomposition
Data Pipeline Design — Lambda/Kappa architecture, CDC, stream processing, and batch pipelines
Design Patterns — GoF patterns and their application in distributed systems
Common Interview Problems — URL shortener, chat system, notification service, and news feed design
